implementation: SQLite schema v2 for projects, skills, bot_profiles, runs, handoffs, approval_requests, sources, artifacts, memory_items and provider_receipts
Run creation and RunEvent creation in one transaction
Run transition, RunEvent append and idempotency record in one transaction
Run segment append and restart readback
same-key replay returns the original transition; same-key different action fails
limitations: The existing runtime still uses InMemoryRunStore; the new repository is not the default control-plane store yet.
Product Builder continuity still records idempotency keys in event data and does not yet atomically write checkpoint, snapshot and idempotency rows through this store.
Project/Bot/Handoff/Approval/Source/Artifact/Memory/ProviderReceipt tables exist, but typed CRUD repositories and receipts are not implemented.
Failure-injection rollback, cross-process contention, crash recovery and backup/restore tests remain pending.
Schema v2 is persistence-contract evidence only; it does not prove model quality or real-world productivity.
next_action: Finish M10-03 by wiring SqliteRunStore into the recoverable runtime path and adding rollback/concurrency/project-isolation tests; keep full Product Builder and HTTP integration in M10-05.
